data.summary: E162 closed the deterministic accessibility repairer on mechanism by its predeclared kill gate: arm B (may only repair what the document states) eliminated 0 of 125 AA-tagged axe instances against a 30% gate, while arm A (may invent) eliminated 99 and fabricated all 104 of its repairs. The closing work was verification and record repair: the draft had carried run 1's arm-B repair count, so the gate table was recomputed from the final bytes and the arm-B row corrected; the canonical arm files, which a backgrounded re-run had rewritten after the last recorded command, were re-summarised under capture and then reproduced from scratch after lib/repair.js was split at the 300-line cap - identical on every field across 27 pages, including all 145 abstention records, which also makes the pipeline's determinism observed rather than asserted. Recorded F129 with its scope (the table as written, not the wider idea), HYPOTHESES-results, STATE.md, and the ranked plan's continuation; untracked the 2.7 MB corpus and node_modules with their inputs pinned by hash; split STATE-next-actions.md back under the cap by invariant; and corrected STATE.md's claim that doc lint exits 0 - it reports 451 inherited violations, none of them from E162.
